notes: Maintenance release: CR audit FX-access (#996). Rules behavior changes: R&D's random access limit counts only cards chosen from the deck, and root upgrades are still accessed after it is reached (CR 7.3.5); a breach of Archives has no limit, so a card entering the discard pile during it is accessed (CR 7.4.6d). Run Ends finishes after a run-end ability's choice, so the run is complete after Boomerang's shuffle (CR 6.9.6d). The Success Phase resolves once per run and a rezzed root card's successful-run ability is marked once: Adrian Seis plays one Psi Game, Hokusai Grid does 1 net damage (CR 6.9.5a, 9.6.4b). Deck searches with criteria (The Foundry, Pivot, Editorial Division, Ob Superheavy Logistics) always ask the searcher, may find nothing, and show the other seat one hidden option (CR 8.7.2e, 10.2.2b); The Foundry always shuffles R&D. A paid ability's effect waits for a choice its cost's checkpoint opened (CR 10.3.4). Architect's 'cannot trash' applies only while it is rezzed (CR 1.8.3a). Pins cards v1.147.25.
